description: This header file declares the interface for a keyword set library, including functions for creating, extending, preparing, executing searches, and freeing keyword sets. It includes data structures and function prototypes for managing keyword matching in C programs, and is part of GNU grep's codebase.

methods.name: kwsalloc
methods.description: Allocates a new keyword set with optional character translation table.

methods.name: kwsincr
methods.description: Increments the keyword set with a new pattern string.

methods.name: kwsprep
methods.description: Prepares the keyword set for searching after all keywords are added.

methods.name: kwsexec
methods.description: Executes a search in a buffer for keywords in the set, returning the match details.

methods.name: kwsfree
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a keyword set.

ctags.name: index
ctags.pattern: /^  int index;			\/* Index number of matching keyword. *\/$/

ctags.name: offset
ctags.pattern: /^  size_t offset[1];		\/* Offset of each submatch. *\/$/

ctags.name: size
ctags.pattern: /^  size_t size[1];		\/* Length of each submatch. *\/$/
